question: What cosmic and iconic attributes are ascribed to the goddess in this praise?
premises: The goddess is addressed as having the universe as her form.
She is called auspicious and pure.
She is described as odd-eyed and three-eyed.
inference: The goddess is praised as the pure, auspicious cosmic form bearing distinctive eyes.
plain_english: O you whose form is the universe, O auspicious one, O pure one, O odd-eyed, O three-eyed one!
